blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper introduces Atunda, the first systematically collected video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves, designed for training and evaluating deep learning models for movement classification. The first phase of the dataset includes nearly 400 videos covering 13 distinct dance moves from African and African Diaspora performative culture, making it the first AI-ready resource of its kind. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate various configurations of temporal convolutional neural networks, achieving a classification accuracy exceeding 95%. The baseline results provide a benchmark for future studies in movement classification, especially in the understudied area of Afrogenic performative culture and tradition. This work lays the foundation for developing in the future digital metrics of similarity, automated attribution systems, and tools that preserve and promote the cultural heritage of Afrogenic dances.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了阿通达,这是第一个系统收集的非洲裔舞蹈动作的视频数据集,旨在为运动分类培训和评价深层学习模式. 数据集的第一阶段包括近400个视频,涵盖来自非洲和非洲散居者表演文化的13个不同的舞蹈动作,使其成为首个AI准备的此类资源. 利用这个数据集,我们训练和评估各种时间演化神经网络的配置,实现分类精度超过95%. 基线结果为今后的迁移分类研究提供了基准,特别是在研究不足的非洲裔表演文化和传统领域。 这项工作为今后开发类似性的数字计量、自动归属系统以及保护和促进非洲裔舞蹈文化遗产的工具奠定了基础。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Dance has been a popular form of creative expression across cultures that has been carried from generation to generation through oral tradition. The importance of documenting and preserving such cultural dances as part of the world’s Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH) has been recognized by the UNESCO 2003 convention ( , 2003 ) . However, in addition to traditional dances, contemporary dance routines have become a well-recognized form of pop culture that is globally disseminated through social media platforms. Through this large-scale creative process, dance moves can become viral, massively reproduced, evolved, and transferred to other media such as video games. These moves can then become a source of profit, as in the case of emotes—short, animated expressions or gestures often used in video games—which can be bought as in-game purchases, generating significant revenue for software development companies, often without crediting the original creators.
blocks.zh: 舞蹈是文化间一种流行的创造性表达形式,通过口述传统代代相传. 教科文组织2003年公约(2003年)确认,必须记录和保存这种文化舞蹈,将其作为世界非物质文化遗产的一部分。 然而,除了传统舞蹈外,当代的舞蹈常规也成为公认的流行文化形式,通过社交媒体平台在全球传播. 通过这个大规模的创作过程,舞蹈动作可以变成病毒,大量复制,进化,并转移到电子游戏等其他媒体. 然后这些动作就可以成为利润的来源,例如,在电子游戏中经常使用的短片、动画表达或手势——这些动作可以作为游戏中购买而购买,为软件开发公司创造大量收入,往往不向原始创造者提供信用。

blocks.en: The influence of technology on pop-culture has created new challenges and possibilities, opening new areas for scholarly research. How can we document the evolution of a popular dance routine? How can we properly attribute a viral dance move to the original creator? Subsequently, can dance as an artistic creation be protected by copyright laws? The key motivation of this paper, and the broader vision behind our work, is to leverage artificial intelligence (AI) methods to create tools for identifying dance moves and facilitating their attribution, with a focus on Afrogenic dance moves.
blocks.zh: 技术对流行文化的影响带来了新的挑战和可能性,为学术研究开辟了新的领域。 如何记录流行舞蹈的演进? 我们怎样才能把病毒性舞蹈的动向 归结到最初的创造者身上? 随后,作为艺术创作的舞蹈能否受到版权法的保护? 本文的关键动机,以及我们工作背后的更广泛的愿景,是利用人工智能(AI)方法创造工具,以识别舞蹈动作并便利其归属,重点是非洲裔舞蹈动作.

blocks.en: According to the literature, there is little protection for ordinary choreographers of dances on social media, and no protection for choreographers’ works that are considered "social dances" or consist of only a few steps, as they are regarded as simple blocks of artistic expression ( Pinkston, 2022 ) . In 2020, JaQuel Knight, an American choreographer and dancer, made a strong push for dance copyrights by encoding his work "Single Ladies" in Labanotation, making it one of the first non-ballet choreographic scores to be approved for copyright ( Robert, 2020 ) . This demonstrated that copyrighting a dance routine is possible if it consists of more than just a few steps and is sufficiently documented in a form of notation that can serve as legal evidence.
blocks.zh: 根据文献,在社交媒体上对舞蹈的普通编舞几乎没有保护,对被视为"社会舞蹈"或仅由几步组成的编舞作品也没有保护,因为它们被认为是艺术表达的简单块(Pinkston,2022). 2020年,美国舞蹈家兼舞蹈家贾奎尔·奈特(JaQuel Knight)通过将他的作品"单身女士"在拉巴诺特化编码,大力推动舞蹈版权,使其成为第一个获得版权许可的非篮板舞蹈分数(Robert,2020)之一. 这表明,如果舞蹈常规不仅包括几个步骤,而且以能够作为法律证据的标记形式充分记录,那么对舞蹈常规的版权是可能的。

blocks.en: Labanotation or kinetography Laban is a notation system developed by Rudolf Laban for recording movement ( Laban, 1966 ; Hutchinson et al., 1977 ; Longstaff, 2001 ) . Laban Movement Analysis (LMA) has been systematically studied ( Bernardet et al., 2019 ) , further developed, and used for encoding movement in a variety of applications involving the study of human motion, such as dance movement therapy, art performances, non-verbal body-based communications ( Roudposhti et al., 2012 ; Davies, 2007 ) , and clinical tests ( Foroud and Whishaw, 2006 ) . Other notable examples include LMA visualization systems for dance instruction and assessment ( Rett et al., 2010 ) as well as for supporting the inclusion of wheelchair dancers ( Xie et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: Labanotation或kinetography Laban是鲁道夫·拉班为记录运动而开发的注解系统(Laban,1966年;Hutchinson等人,1977年;Longstaff,2001年)。 Laban Movement Analysis(LMA)被系统研究(Bernardet等人,2019年),进一步发展,并用于人类运动研究的各种应用中的编码运动,如舞蹈运动疗法,艺术表演,非言语体基通信(Roudposhti等人,2012年;Davies,2007年),临床测试(Foroud and Whishaw,2006年). 其他显著的例子包括LMA可视化系统用于舞蹈教学和评估(Rett等人,2010年)以及支持纳入轮椅舞者(Xie等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Several computer-based LMA methods have been developed for the automatic generation of Labanotation from motion capture data, aiming to streamline the labor-intensive process of manual notation ( Li et al., 2019 ; Cui et al., 2021 ) . The advancements on motion capturing technologies and their availability as low-cost consumer devices, such as the series of Kinect sensors by Microsoft (2011-2023), have contributed significantly to this field. Several Kinect-based methods for LMA have been proposed ( Santos and Dias, 2011 ; Bernstein et al., 2015 ) , with various applications, such as emotional motion recognition ( Kim et al., 2013 ) , Labanotation instruction ( Raheb et al., 2021 ) , automated dance evaluation ( Jang et al., 2017 ) , and others.
blocks.zh: 已经开发了几种基于计算机的LMA方法,从运动捕捉数据中自动生成Labanotation,目的是简化人工标记的劳动密集型过程(Li等人,2019年;Cui等人,2021年)。 运动捕捉技术的进步及其作为低成本消费设备的可用性,例如微软公司系列的Kinect传感器(2011-2023年),对这一领域作出了重大贡献。 已经提出了几种基于基内克特的LMA方法(Santos和Dias,2011年;Bernstein等人,2015年),有各种应用,如情感运动识别(Kim等人,2013年),Labanotation指令(Raheb等人,2021年),自动化舞蹈评价(Jang等人,2017年)等.

blocks.en: Beyond Labanotation, several machine learning algorithms, such as Random Decision Forest, Multi-Layer Perceptron and Multi-class Support Vector Machines have been used for analyzing motion data captured from Kinect or other motion tracking sensors ( Ajili et al., 2017 ; Guo et al., 2022 ; Jin et al., 2022b ) . Deep learning methods such as convolutional neural networks with long short-term memory have been used for dance emotion recognition ( Wang et al., 2020 ) and classification of choreographic primitives ( Bakalos et al., 2020a ) . Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2015 ) proposed a 3D spatio-temporal convolutional neural network (TCN) architecture. This method directly inputs videos into the TCN, utilizing both the spatial aspect of pixels and the temporal aspect of continuous video frames for classification. Similarly, other types of deep learning architectures, such as Visual Geometry Group Networks, have been used for movement recognition, providing real-time feedback in computer-assisted dance education ( Jin et al., 2022a ; Kang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 除了Labanotation之外,一些机器学习算法,如Random Decide Forest,Multi-Layer Perceptoron和Multi-class Support Vector Machines,也被用于分析从Kinect或其他运动跟踪传感器中捕获的运动数据(Ajili等人,2017年;Guo等人,2022年;Jin等人,2022年b). 深层次的学习方法,如具有长期短期记忆的演化神经网络,被用于舞蹈情感识别(Wang等人,2020年)和舞蹈原始生物分类(Bakalos等人,2020年a). 孙等. (Sun et al.,2015) 提出3Dspatio-时序神经网络(TCN)架构. 这种方法直接将视频输入TCN,既利用像素的空间方面,也利用连续视频帧的时间方面进行分类. 同样,其他类型的深层学习建筑,例如视觉几何组网络,也被用于运动识别,在计算机辅助舞蹈教育中提供实时反馈(Jin等人,2022a); Kang等人, 2023年 ).

blocks.en: For an in-depth overview of techniques for capturing and storing dance-related content, as well as methods for extracting representative primitive patterns, recognizing choreographic poses and movements, analyzing choreographic patterns, and summarizing or evaluating performances, the reader is referred to recent literature reviews ( Kico et al., 2018 ; Rallis et al., 2020 ; Protopapadakis et al., 2020 ; Hou et al., 2022 ; Reshma et al., 2023 ; Paul et al., 2025a ) that discuss the strengths and limitations of the state-of-the-art methods.
blocks.zh: 为了深入概述采集和存储舞蹈相关内容的技术以及提取代表性原始图案的方法,识别舞蹈姿势和运动,分析舞蹈图案,总结或评价表演,读者参考了近期文献评论(Kico等人,2018年;Rallis等人,2020年;Protopadakis等人,2020年;Hou等人,2022年;Reshma等人,2023年;Paul等人,2025a年),讨论了最新方法的优缺点.

blocks.en:
This technological revolution has resulted in many useful end-user applications, such as real-time feedback for dance learning and training ( Li, 2023 ; Rallis et al., 2021 ; Bakalos et al., 2020b ; Raheb et al., 2019 ) , dance summarization ( Voulodimos et al., 2018 ; Rallis et al., 2018 ; Rallis et al., 2017 ) , virtual and augmented reality applications for cultural and social dancing ( Pistola et al., 2021 ; Sarupuri et al., 2023 ; Bozia, 2018 ) , and
AI-generated choreographies ( Papillon et al., 2023 ; Sun et al., 2020 ) . Several of these applications have been showcased across a wide variety of genres, including, among others, Cantonese opera ( Chung, 2023 ) , Indian classical dance ( Parthasarathy and Palanichamy, 2023 ; Dewan et al., 2018 ) including Bharatanatyam dance ( Bhuyan et al., 2022 ; Paul et al., 2025b ; Paul et al., 2023 ) , Lazgi dance ( Skublewska-Paszkowska et al., 2021 ) , indigenous Aeta dances ( Mindoro et al., 2021 ) , Slovak folk dances ( Hajdin et al., 2019 ) , Greek folk dances ( Aristidou et al., 2015 ) , and martial arts demonstrations ( Yamanaka et al., 2021 ) . This multitude of studies has led to the development of open-access movement databases, some of which are specific to particular genre or culture ( , 2018 ) , and others that are multi-cultural such as the TikTok dance move dataset that was primarily used for depth estimation of humans ( Jafarian and Park, 2021 ) and the AIST Dance Video Database, which focuses on 10 general and well known dance genres, and includes multiple performers, and cameras ( Tsuchida et al., 2019 ) . Finally, there has been significant number of annotation tools ( El Raheb and Ioannidis, 2021 ) , and open-source pose tracking libraries such as SAM-Body4D, FMPose3D, MediaPipe, Yolo8, Detectron2, and others, which are important to further facilitate research in this field ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Nguyen et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2019 ; Aboah et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en: Despite the plethora of publications on this broad topic of research, there are not many studies with focus on Afrogenic dance moves or any systematically recorded datasets to facilitate research on African dance culture. Furthermore, there is a significant gap in the literature regarding computer-assisted mechanisms for attributing dance moves to their creators. Identifying solutions to this problem will have a major impact, particularly on underrepresented dance creators, who often go unaccredited despite their dance moves becoming viral on social media and being monetized in video games ( Pinkston, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管关于这一广泛研究专题的出版物很多,但没有许多研究侧重于非洲裔舞蹈运动或任何系统记录的数据集,以促进对非洲舞蹈文化的研究。 此外,有关将舞蹈动作归于创作者的计算机辅助机制的文献存在很大差距。 尽管舞蹈动作在社交媒体上变得具有病毒性,并在电子游戏中被货币化(Pinkston, 2022),

blocks.en: The work presented in this paper is part of our broader project vision to develop a deep learning model that can successfully classify different dance movements, laying the foundation for future development of digital metrics of similarity. These metrics could be used to track the evolution of dance moves, provide attribution, and help protect dance artists’ creative work. By using deep learning to classify movements, the model and its predictions can serve as evidence of ownership for digital assets, such as digitally encoded dance routines, thereby helping creators receive their deserved attribution.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍的工作是我们开发一个能够成功划分不同舞蹈运动的深度学习模式的更广泛项目愿景的一部分,为今后开发类似数字度量衡奠定了基础. 这些衡量标准可用于跟踪舞蹈动作的演变,提供归属,并帮助保护舞蹈艺术家的创作作品. 通过使用深层学习来对运动进行分类,模型及其预测可以作为数字资产所有权的证据,如数字编码舞蹈常规,从而帮助创作者获得他们应得的归属.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce a novel video dataset consisting of 13 different African and African Diaspora (Afrogenic) dance moves, performed in almost 400 videos. This dataset was created through Project Atunda, an interdisciplinary research initiative involving a team of artists, scientists, and researchers who collaborated to build an AI-ready video data bank of Afrogenic dances. The dataset created in this project was used to train and test a preliminary deep learning model based on a temporal convolutional neural network. The results are discussed in detail and serve as a benchmark for assessing other dance move classification methods in the future.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了一个由13个不同的非洲和非洲散居地(Afrogenic)舞蹈动作组成的新视频数据集,在近400个视频中表演. 这个数据集是通过阿通达项目(Project Atunda)创建的,这是一个跨学科的研究举措,参与者包括一群艺术家,科学家和研究人员,他们合作建立了AI-准备的非洲裔舞蹈视频数据库. 在这个项目中创建的数据集被用来训练和测试基于时间演化神经网络的初步深度学习模型. 详细讨论了结果,并作为今后评估其他舞蹈动作分类方法的基准。

blocks.en: The key contributions of this paper are as follows: 1) We present Atunda, a novel video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves that has been systematically collected and curated for training machine learning models. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset of its kind and aims to promote and facilitate research on Afrogenic dance and culture. 2) We present results from training and validating various configurations of temporal convolutional neural networks using the Atunda dataset. The results demonstrate classification accuracy exceeding 90% across all 13 types of dance moves in our dataset and can be used as a baseline benchmark for future studies utilizing the Atunda dataset.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下: 1) 我们介绍Atunda,一个有关非洲裔舞蹈动作的新型视频数据集,已经系统收集并用于培训机器学习模型。 据我们所知,这是第一套此类数据集,目的是促进和促进对非洲裔舞蹈和文化的研究。 (2) 我们利用阿通达数据集,介绍培训和验证各种时间演化神经网络配置的结果。 结果显示,在我们的数据集中,所有13种舞蹈运动的分类精确度超过90%,并可作为今后利用阿通达数据集进行研究的基准基准。

blocks.en: 2. Dataset Development
blocks.zh: 2. 数据集开发

blocks.en: This section presents Atunda, a video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves created specifically for this project. The term "Atunda" has its roots in the Yoruba language, which is widely spoken in Nigeria, particularly in the southwestern region. In Yoruba, "Atunda" is often associated with the idea of renewal or rebirth. The concept behind "Atunda" is often linked to the idea of starting afresh, creating something new out of something old, or experiencing a form of renaissance. The purpose of the Atunda dataset is to provide researchers in the field of human action recognition with a unique set of movements typical of Afrogenic dance, which can be used for machine learning training and testing. Contrary to other dance movement datasets discussed in Sec. 1 , which include samples from multiple genres, such as the TikTok ( Jafarian and Park, 2021 ) and AIST ( Tsuchida et al., 2019 ) datasets, our Atunda dataset provides a focused, Afrogenic-specific set of movements capturing diverse dance practices, ranging from heritage-inspired forms to modern street and popular Afrobeats styles.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍Atunda, 专为这个项目制作的非裔舞蹈动作的视频数据集. "阿通达"一词起源于约鲁巴语,在尼日利亚,特别是在西南地区,该语广为流传. 在约鲁巴语中,"阿通达"经常与更新或重生的思想有关. "阿通达"背后的概念往往与开始新鲜,从旧事物中创造新事物,或经历某种复兴形式的想法联系在一起. 阿通达数据集的目的是为人类行动识别领域的研究人员提供一套典型的非洲裔舞蹈的独特运动,可用于机器学习培训和测试. 与 Sec. 1 中讨论过的其他舞蹈运动数据集相反,我们的Atunda数据集提供了一套集中的,非洲裔特定的运动,捕捉了多种舞蹈习俗,从传统激发的形式到现代街头和流行的非裔风格。

blocks.en: Afrogenic dance movements encompass a broad spectrum of expressive practices shaped by diverse historical, cultural, and technological contexts. The dance moves included in the Atunda dataset reflect this variability and can be broadly grouped into three overlapping categories: heritage-derived and ceremonial forms, popular music-driven choreographies, and contemporary street and social media trends. This categorization highlights the range of transmission pathways through which African dance vocabularies evolve, from traditional communal performance and ritual practice to commercial music circulation and digital platform dissemination. Although these categories are not rigid, they provide a useful framework for understanding the sociocultural dimensions that influence the movement structures represented in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 非洲裔舞蹈运动包括由不同历史、文化和技术背景形成的范围广泛的表达做法。 阿通达数据集中包含的舞蹈动作反映了这种变异性,可以大致分为三个重叠的类别:遗产衍生形式和礼仪形式,流行音乐驱动的舞曲,以及当代街道和社交媒体的趋势. 这种分类突出了非洲舞蹈词汇的传播途径范围,从传统的社区表演和仪式做法到商业音乐流通和数字平台传播。 虽然这些类别并不僵硬,但它们为理解影响数据集中运动结构的社会文化层面提供了一个有用的框架。

blocks.en: The first category includes movements rooted in cultural heritage and ceremonial performance, such as Akwaaba, Omo Iya, and Bante. These dances are closely tied to communal identity, ritual symbolism, and intergenerational cultural transmission. Akwaaba, (meaning “welcome” in the Twi language of Ghana’s Akan people) represents a welcoming, high-energy West African dance and drumming tradition rooted in Akan culture, commonly performed at festivals, formal receptions, and state-sponsored cultural events, where it expresses hospitality and reinforces collective identity ( Cummings-Yeates, 2019 ) . Omo Iya, grounded in Yoruba cultural traditions, reflects themes of kinship, ancestry, and communal celebration, with connections to ceremonial forms such as Gelede that honor feminine power and social harmony. Similarly, Bante is associated with Yoruba charm-related practices. In these cases, dance extends beyond entertainment to serve ritual, social, and at times political purposes through the preservation and public performance of cultural identity.
blocks.zh: 第一类包括植根于文化遗产和礼仪表演的运动,如Akwaaba、Omo Iya和Bante。 这些舞蹈与社区身份、仪式象征和代际文化传播密切相关。 Akwaaba(意为加纳阿坎人Twi语的“欢迎”)代表着一种植根于阿坎文化的欢迎性、高能的西非舞蹈和鼓乐传统,通常在节日、正式招待会和国家赞助的文化活动中表演,表达热情的款待和强化了集体认同(Cummings-Yeates,2019年)。 奥莫·伊亚以约鲁巴文化传统为基础,反映了亲属关系、祖先和社区庆典等主题,与尊重女性权力和社会和谐的礼仪形式有联系。 同样,班特也与约鲁巴魅力相关。 在这些情况下,舞蹈超越娱乐,通过保存和公开展示文化特征,服务于仪式、社会、有时是政治目的。

blocks.en: The second category consists of dances popularized through commercial music and mass media, including Alanta, Etighi, and Chocobodi. These movements illustrate the role of the African music industry in transforming localized dance practices into nationally and internationally recognized choreographic forms. Alanta, which emerged in Nigeria in 2007 through Artquake’s music video, became widely recognized for its theatrical hand gestures and exaggerated facial expressions ( Hutchison and Okoye, 2018 ) . Etighi, originally associated with the Ibibio and Efik peoples of Akwa Ibom, gained widespread visibility through its adaptation in Nigerian popular music videos, particularly through artist-driven dissemination ( , 2017 ) . Chocobodi, popularized by A-Star, represents a newer Afrobeats-associated dance style characterized by energetic structured movement combined with freestyle interpretation ( A-Star, 2018 ) . These dances occupy a sociocultural space where performance, entertainment, and media circulation intersect, reflecting how contemporary African popular culture reshapes traditional and emerging movement vocabularies.
blocks.zh: 第二类包括通过商业音乐和大众传媒普及的舞蹈,包括阿兰塔,埃蒂吉和乔科博迪. 这些运动表明了非洲音乐产业在将本地舞蹈做法转变为国家和国际承认的舞蹈形式方面的作用。 Alanta于2007年通过Artquake的音乐录影带在尼日利亚出现,因其戏剧手势和夸张的面部表情(Hutchison and Okoye, 2018)而获得广泛认可. Etighi最初与Akwa Ibom的Ibibio和Efik民族有关,通过在尼日利亚流行音乐视频中的改编,特别是通过艺术家驱动的传播(2017年),获得了广泛的知名度. 由A-Star普及的Chocobodi代表一种较新的Afrobeats相关舞蹈风格,其特征是充满活力的结构化运动与自由风格的诠释相结合(A-Star,2018). 这些舞蹈占据着社会文化空间,表演、娱乐和媒体流通相互交织,反映了当代非洲流行文化如何重塑传统和新兴运动词汇。

blocks.en: The third category includes contemporary urban street and digitally mediated dance trends such as Gbeku, Gwara, Jazze, and Swo. These forms are primarily shaped by youth culture, social interaction, and online participatory platforms such as TikTok and Instagram. Gbeku, associated with Nigeria’s Zanku movement and artists such as Zlatan, emphasizes relaxed rhythmic grooves and reflects the creativity of Lagos street dance culture ( Zlatan, 2019 ) . Gwara, derived from Southern African street dance traditions, was created by disc jockey and producer DJ Bongz, and was heavily performed and popularized in the mid-2010s ( Zeeman, 2018 ) , while Jazze represents Gabonese urban Afro-dance emphasizing grounded movement and body isolations. Similarly, Swo exemplifies short-form social media choreography designed for rapid replication and adaptation. These movements are characterized by fluid evolution, peer-driven innovation, and transnational digital dissemination, demonstrating how African dance continues to adapt to contemporary social and technological environments.
blocks.zh: 第三类包括当代城市街道和数字化调解的舞蹈趋势,如Gbeku,Gwara,Jazze,和Swo. 这些形式主要由青年文化,社会互动,以及TikTok和Instagram等在线参与平台塑造. Gbeku与尼日利亚的赞库运动及兹拉坦等艺术家相关, Gwara源于南部非洲街舞传统,由碟片骑手和制片人DJ Bongz创作,在2010年代中期(Zeeman,2018年)大量表演和普及,而Jazze代表加蓬城市非洲舞强调有根底的运动和身体隔离. 同样, Swo展示了为快速复制和适应而设计的短式社交媒体配音. 这些运动的特点是流畅演变、同行驱动的创新和跨国数字传播,表明非洲舞蹈如何继续适应当代社会和技术环境。

blocks.en: The Atunda dataset videos are systematically collected by the QDance Center ( , 2025 ) . The QDance Center is a creative incubator based in Lagos, Nigeria, that leverages artistic competence for sociocultural development. The center is at the forefront of showcasing Nigerian culture to the world through dance, music, and cultural engagements. Its mission follows a six-pronged approach known as QDance CREATE, focusing on Community, Research, Education, Artistic excellence, Technocultural advancements, and Entrepreneurship. The QDance Center is the custodian of the Atunda video dataset and is responsible for the curation, and distribution of the videos, while the performers retain the ownership of their artwork.
blocks.zh: Atunda数据集视频由QDance中心系统收集(2025年)。 QDance中心是一个位于尼日利亚拉各斯的创意孵化器,利用艺术能力促进社会文化发展. 中心通过舞蹈、音乐和文化活动向世界展示尼日利亚文化。 其使命遵循一种称为 " QDance CREATE " 的六管齐下的方法,重点是社区、研究、教育、艺术优秀、技术文化进步和创业。 QDance中心是Atunda录像数据集的保管人,负责录像的整理和分发,而表演者则保留其艺术品的所有权.

blocks.en: The development of the Atunda dataset follows a three-phase strategy designed to ensure scalability, data quality, and broad community participation. In the first phase, the results of which are presented in this paper, a pilot dataset was created consisting of 13 dance moves and approximately 400 videos, all performed by dancers from the QDance Center. The objective of this phase was to establish a baseline dataset and identify effective recording and annotation practices that will guide subsequent data collection. During this phase, all labels were assigned by expert members of the QDance Center to ensure high annotation quality. In the second phase, the dataset will be expanded through a crowd-sourcing approach involving the wider network of the QDance Center, resulting in an intermediate dataset of approximately 50 dance moves and 1,000 videos. This phase focuses on the development of a dedicated crowd-sourcing platform ( , 2025 ) , the establishment of curation and quality control criteria, and a hybrid labeling process in which labels are initially provided by the performers and subsequently verified by expert members of the QDance Center. Both the second and third phases are supported by sponsorship from the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, which provides compensation to participating performers; verification of labels by QDance Center experts is required prior to payment approval. In the final phase, the dataset will be further extended to include up to 100 dance moves and approximately 2,000 videos, following the same crowd-sourcing and expert-validated labeling process as in the second phase.
blocks.zh: 阿通达数据集的开发遵循了三阶段战略,目的是确保可扩展性、数据质量和广泛的社区参与。 第一阶段的成果在本文中介绍,建立了一个由13个舞蹈动作和约400个视频组成的试点数据集,全部由来自QDance中心的舞者表演. 这一阶段的目标是建立一套基线数据并确定有效的记录和说明做法,以指导随后的数据收集工作。 在这一阶段,所有标签都由QDance中心的专家成员指定,以确保高质量的注释。 在第二阶段,数据集将通过由QDance中心更广泛的网络参与的众包方式加以扩展,形成一个大约50个舞蹈动作和1000个视频的中间数据集. 这一阶段的重点是开发专用的众包平台(2025年),制定馆藏和质量控制标准,以及混合标签流程,其中标签最初由表演者提供,随后由QDance中心的专家成员验证. 第二和第三阶段都得到了罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊基金会的赞助支持,该基金会向参与的表演者提供补偿;在支付批准前,需要QDance中心专家对标签进行核查. 在最后阶段,数据集将进一步扩大,包括多达100个舞蹈动作和大约2 000个视频,采用与第二阶段相同的众包和专家认证标签程序。

blocks.en: To ensure consistency and sufficient representation across all phases, the Atunda dataset follows a standardized data collection protocol. Specifically, each dance move is performed by at least five different performers and is represented by a minimum of 15 videos. To facilitate scalability and ease of contribution, all videos adhere to a simple and reproducible recording setup inspired by social media practices: monocular, portrait-oriented recordings that capture the full body of the dancer in a front-facing view, performed in everyday clothing and natural, non-controlled environments.
blocks.zh: 为确保所有阶段的一致性和充分代表性,阿通达数据集遵循标准化的数据收集协议。 具体来说,每次舞蹈动作至少由5名不同的表演者表演,并且最少由15个视频代表. 为了便于扩展和方便贡献,所有视频都坚持由社交媒体惯例所启发的简单而可复制的录音设置:单曲,面向肖像的录音,在前视中捕捉舞者全身,在日常服装和自然,非控制的环境中表演.

blocks.en: In this paper, we present the first phase of the Atunda dataset. Each video captures a specific dance move performed by a single dancer or a pair of dancers in outdoor urban settings in Lagos, Nigeria under sunny conditions, as shown in Fig. 1 . This design choice follows the aforementioned established protocol and reflects real-world recording conditions while eliminating the need for specialized equipment, thereby enabling straightforward replication and supporting future dataset expansion through crowd-sourcing, as discussed in Sec. 6 .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了阿通达数据集的第一阶段. 如图1所示,每段影片都记录了尼日利亚拉各斯市户外城市环境中一位舞者或一对舞者在阳光明媚的条件下进行的具体舞蹈动作。 如第6节所述,这种设计选择遵循上述既定规程,反映了真实世界的录制条件,同时取消了对专门设备的需求,从而能够通过众包直接复制和支持今后数据集的扩展。

blocks.en: The current dataset consists of 397 videos totaling 45 minutes and covering the following 13 movements: Gwara, Obloblo, Etighi, Wakanco, Chocobodi, Jazzé, Bante, Akwaaba, Gbeku, Shooo, Swo, Omo Iya, and Alanta. The dance moves were performed by 17 members of the QDance Center (16 male and 1 female), aged between 20 and 30 years, all with a minimum of five years of dance experience, who voluntarily agreed to be recorded for the purposes of this project. Each movement was performed 30 times by different dance artists in different outdoor environments and with different clothing, resulting in an equal number of videos, except for Bante with 26, Gwara with 38, and Obloblo with 33 videos. Depending on the type and complexity of the dance move, each performance lasts between 4 and 14 seconds. The majority of the videos in the dataset are single-person performances, with only a few featuring multiple dancers. All videos are in a 9:16 aspect ratio (vertical) and vary in resolution and frame rate, as detailed in Table 1 . The table reports, for each type of movement, the total number of videos, their vertical resolution, their frame rate, the total number of frames, and the total duration of the videos.
blocks.zh: 目前的数据集由397个视频组成,共计45分钟,涵盖以下13个运动:格瓦拉,奥布洛洛,埃蒂吉,瓦坎科,乔科博迪,贾泽,班特,阿克瓦巴,格贝库,舒奥,斯沃,奥莫·伊亚和阿兰塔. 舞蹈动作由17名年龄在20至30岁之间的QDance中心成员(16名男性和1名女性)进行,他们都拥有至少5年的舞蹈经验,他们自愿同意为该项目的目的录制. 每一次运动都由不同的舞蹈艺术家在不同的户外环境和不同的服装中表演30次,导致视频数量相等,只有班特与26人,格瓦拉与38人,奥布洛洛与33人视频. 根据舞蹈动作的类型和复杂性,每场表演持续4至14秒. 数据集的视频大多是单人表演,只有少数以多个舞者为主角. 所有视频都以9:16的宽比(垂直),分辨率和帧率各有不同,详见表1. 表格报告每类移动,视频总数,垂直分辨率,帧率,帧总数,视频总持续时间.

blocks.en: Since the primary technological purpose of this dataset is to build dance move classifiers, it is important to note its limitations. First of all, not all dance moves are equally represented with the same amount of data. Although each dance move has a similar number of associated videos, the actual amount of data varies depending on the number of frames in each video. Table 1 shows the total number of frames for each type of dance move. It is evident that there are some imbalances in the dataset by type, which may require data balancing before training a machine learning model. Furthermore, the gender diversity is evidently limited in the preliminary dataset due to the limitations in our cohort. As we continue to expand this dataset during phases 2 and 3, we aim to collect data that will result in a more balanced representation and involve the broader community through crowd sourcing.
blocks.zh: 由于本数据集的主要技术目的是构建舞蹈动作分类器,因此有必要注意到其局限性. 首先,并非所有舞蹈动作都以同样数量的数据得到同等的体现. 虽然每一次舞蹈动作的关联视频数量相近,但实际数据数量因每个视频的帧数而异. 表1显示了每类舞蹈动作的帧总数. 显然,数据集在类型上存在一些不平衡,这可能需要在培训机器学习模型之前平衡数据。 此外,由于我们群体的限制,初步数据集的性别多样性显然有限。 随着我们在第二阶段和第三阶段继续扩大这一数据集,我们的目标是收集数据,从而实现更均衡的代表性,并通过人群来源使更广泛的社区参与。

blocks.en: Finally, as indicated in Table 1 , 84 of the 397 videos were captured in 60 fps, with the remaining 313 videos in 30 fps. Since the temporal dimension of the input to a machine learning model is represented as discrete frames, any differences in frame rate may cause the algorithm to perceive some dance moves as slower or faster than others. Although this could be easily mitigated by normalizing the frame rates, we chose to leave the input videos unaltered during data processing to prevent the model from developing a bias toward a specific frame rate or movement speed, thereby accommodating variability in creative expression. It should also be noted that the videos were recorded as standalone rhythmic movements rather than as part of choreographies accompanied by specific music; therefore, this dataset is not suitable for music–movement synchronization studies ( Endo et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 最后,如表1所示,397个视频中有84个在60英尺处被捕获,其余313个视频在30英尺处被捕获. 由于对机器学习模型的输入的时间维度以离散帧表示,帧率的任何差异都可能导致算法将一些舞蹈运动视为比其他舞蹈慢或快. 虽然这可以通过使帧率正常化来轻松缓解,但我们选择在数据处理过程中不修改输入视频,以防止模型形成对特定帧率或移动速度的偏差,从而适应创造性表达中的可变性. 还应指出的是,这些录像是作为单独的节奏运动录制的,而不是作为配有特定音乐的配乐的一部分;因此,这个数据集不适合音乐-运动同步研究(Endo等人,2024年).

blocks.zh: 3个 数据处理

blocks.en: Access to the raw videos can be requested from the QDance Center ( , 2025 ) by providing a data review protocol approved by the ethics review board of an academic institution. The University of Florida was the first research institution to partner with the QDance Center and gain access to the Atunda video dataset for dance move classification research under the IRB202500278 data review protocol, which was approved by the University of Florida Institutional Review Board. This section describes the data processing steps applied to the Atunda dataset, with two main goals: 1) to extract non-identifying descriptive features from each video and create a comprehensive metadata record to be included in the Atunda dataset, and 2) to train a preliminary machine learning model that can serve as a comparative reference or benchmark for future dance move classification studies using the Atunda dataset.
blocks.zh: 可从QDance中心(2025年)索取原始视频,提供经学术机构道德审查委员会批准的数据审查协议。 佛罗里达大学是第一个与QDance Center合作的研究机构,并且根据IRB20250278数据审查协议获得Atunda视频数据集用于舞蹈动作分类研究,该协议得到了佛罗里达大学机构审查委员会的批准. 本节介绍适用于阿通达数据集的数据处理步骤,主要有两个目标: 1)从每段视频中提取未识别的描述性特征,并创建一个包含在阿通达数据集的综合元数据记录,2)培训一个初步的机器学习模型,作为使用阿通达数据集进行未来舞蹈动作分类研究的比较参考或基准.

blocks.en: 3.1. Input feature extraction
blocks.zh: 3.1. 输入特性提取

blocks.en: Pose-based methods are considered one of the most promising directions for human action recognition (HAR), as indicated in a recent literature survey by Kulbacki et al. ( Kulbacki et al., 2023 ) . One reason pose-based HAR is promising is that pose estimation methods are abundant and provide enriched data that are highly descriptive and simpler to use for further training. The process of calculating pose-based input features for machine learning begins by extracting individual frames from each video and processing them with a skeleton fitting method such as MediaPipe Pose Detection library ( Nguyen et al., 2022 ) , FMPose3D ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , Detectron2 ( Wu et al., 2019 ) , Yolo8 ( Aboah et al., 2023 ) , SAM-Body3D ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , SAM-Body4D ( Gao et al., 2025 ) or other pose estimation algorithms.
blocks.zh: 如Kulbacki等人最近进行的文献调查所示,基于Pose的方法被认为是人类行动承认的最有希望的方向之一。 (Kulbacki等人,2023年). 以假名为基础的 " 哈尔 " 有希望的一个原因是, " 阿尔法 " 具有丰富的估计方法,提供了内容丰富的数据,这些数据描述性很强,便于进一步培训使用。 机器学习基于姿势的输入特性的计算过程开始于从每个视频中提取单个帧并用一个骨架配置方法处理,如MediaPipe Pose检测库(Nguyen等人,2022年),FMPose3D (Wang等人,2026年),探测器2 (Wu等人,2019年),Yolo8(Aboah等人,2023年),SAM-Body3D (Yang等人,2026年),SAM-Body4D (Gao 等人,2025年)或其他设置估计算法.

blocks.en: For example, in the case of MediaPipe, the human pose detection model estimates from each video frame the location of 33 body landmarks and calculates the following four values for each landmark: x x (the horizontal coordinate), y y (the vertical coordinate), z z (the depth of the point), and v ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ b ​ i ​ l ​ i ​ t ​ y visibility (with value in the range [ 0 − 1 ] [0-1] indicating the visibility status of the point). In our context, the 3-dimensional skeleton information in this dataset can enhance performance in human action recognition due to its rich informational content ( Le et al., 2022 ) . The locations of these 33 landmarks correspond to major joints in the human body as well as distinct facial landmarks and are shown in the skeleton estimation panel in Fig. 2 . It should also be noted that another benefit of this data modality is that although it is very descriptive of the human pose, it does not contain any identifiable information of the human subjects in the video, such as facial characteristics, tattoos, or other information that could be considered sensitive, which satisfies the requirements of our institutionally approved data review protocol.
blocks.zh: 例如MediaPipe,人类的姿势检测模型估计从每个视频框中得出33个身体地标的位置,并计算每个地标的以下四个值:xx(水平坐标),yy(垂直坐标),z(点深度),vi s i b i l i t y可见度(其值范围为[0−1][0-1]表示点的可见度状态). 在我们的背景下,本数据集的三维骨架信息由于其丰富的信息内容(Le等人,2022年),可以提高人类行动识别的性能. 这33个地标的位置对应人体中的主要关节以及独特的面部地标,并在图2的骨架估计面板中显示. 还应指出的是,这种数据模式的另一个好处是,虽然它非常描述人体的姿势,但是它没有包含视频中人类主体的任何可识别的信息,如面部特征,纹身,或其他可被认为敏感的信息,这些都符合我们经机构批准的数据审查协议的要求.

blocks.en: There are two possible forms of output provided by MediaPipe pose detection algorithm: normalized and world landmarks. The normalized landmarks are the projections of the 3D landmarks onto the image frame. For example, the normalized landmark coordinates x = 0 x=0 and y = 0 y=0 correspond to the top-left corner of the frame, while x = 1 x=1 and y = 1 y=1 correspond to the bottom-right corner of the frame, regardless of the aspect ratio. It should be noted that the values of x x or y y outside the [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] range correspond to inferred locations that are not visible within the image frame. For the z z coordinate, the depth is measured relative to the center of the pelvis (midpoint between the hip) and normalized on a scale similar to that of the x x coordinate. Negative values of z z indicate that the landmark is closer to the camera than the pelvis, while values of z > 0 z>0 indicate that it is farther away. In essence, the coordinate system for normalized landmarks is relative to the video frame and is useful for identifying the exact pixel location of each landmark.
blocks.zh: MediaPipe提供的输出有两种可能的形式:正版和世界地标. 正常化的地标是3D地标在图像框上的投影. 例如,正常化的地标坐标x=0x=0,y=0y=0对应帧的左上角,而x=1x=1,y=1y对应帧的右下角,无论宽度比如何. 应当指出,[0, 1] [0, 1] 范围以外的x x 或 y 值,与图像框内不可见的推断位置相对应. 对于z z坐标,深度相对于骨盆中心(臀部之间的中点)进行测量,并以类似于x x坐标的尺度实现正常化. z z的负值表示地标比骨盆更接近相机,而z > 0 z>0的值则表示距离更远. 实质上,规范化地标的坐标系统相对视频帧,对确定每个地标的确切像素位置有用.

blocks.en: World landmarks are 3D coordinate estimations in a relative 3D space based on the visual information captured in the video frames. More specifically, the coordinates of the world landmarks represent 3D points in a coordinate system with origin at the midpoint of the hips. However, it should be noted that due to the lack of geometric information in monocular systems, it is difficult to accurately estimate the actual real-world scale of the coordinate system, and consequently we cannot rely on these coordinates to make anthropometric measurements, such as estimating the real length of the limbs, without introducing additional input or constraints. However, regardless of the lack of scale, the world landmarks represent a reliable descriptor of the human pose, which satisfies our needs in this project. For the purposes of our experimentation, we trained our models using both normalized and world landmark features.
blocks.zh: 世界地标是相对的3D空间中基于视频帧中捕获的视觉信息的3D坐标估计. 更具体地说,世界地标的坐标代表坐标系统中的3D点,起源于臀部中点. 然而,应该注意的是,由于单体系统缺乏几何信息,因此很难准确估计坐标系统的实际现实世界尺度,因此我们不能依靠这些坐标来进行人体测量,如估算四肢的实际长度,而不引入额外的输入或约束. 然而,无论规模如何,世界地标代表着人类形象的可靠描述,它满足了我们在这一项目中的需求。 为了实验的目的,我们利用正常化和世界标志性特征培训了我们的模型。

blocks.en: For each video, all calculated features were stored in a raw feature array of size ( F , 33 , 4 ) (F,33,4) , where F F denotes the number of frames in a video, 33 is the number of body landmarks, and 4 is the number of estimated values per landmark. For machine learning training or testing, this array can be sliced to retrieve the desired input based on the features selected for a particular experiment. For example, when training a model using only the x x and y y coordinates and with a 16-frame time window, the resulting size of the input array would be ( 16 , 33 , 2 ) (16,33,2) . This array can then be reshaped into an array X X of size ( 16 , 66 ) (16,66) for input into a machine learning model, where the first dimension is the temporal dimension and the second is the feature dimension.
blocks.zh: 对于每段视频,所有计算出的功能都存储在大小(F,33,4)的原始特征阵列中(F,33,4),其中FF表示视频中的帧数,33表示机构地标数,4表示每个地标的估计值数. 对于机器学习训练或测试,这个阵列可以根据特定实验所选的特性进行切片,以获取所需的输入. 例如,在培训只使用xx和yy坐标且带有16帧时间窗口的模型时,所产生的输入阵列大小将是(16,33,2) (16,33,2). 这个阵列然后可以重塑成大小(16,66)的XX阵列(16,66),用于输入机器学习模型,其中第一个维度是时间维度,第二个维度是特征维度.

blocks.en: 3.2. Additional feature Calculation
blocks.zh: 3.2. 附加特性

blocks.en: In addition to the landmark position data extracted from the raw input video frames, other higher-order descriptors of the human posture can be calculated by utilizing the placement of each landmark/joint within the human skeleton and the relative dynamics between these joints ( Song et al., 2020 ) . For example, landmark velocities, joint angles, and angular velocities can be derived and included in the feature vector to test whether they can improve movement classification.

blocks.en: 4. Machine Learning Setup
blocks.zh: 4个 机器学习设置

blocks.en: After the preparation of the input feature data as described in Sec. 3 , we used them to train a series of machine learning models for the classification of dance moves. This section describes the machine learning architecture and training parameters that were used, as well as the different configurations of the input feature vector chosen in each experiment.
blocks.zh: 在制作 Sec. 3 描述的输入特征数据后,我们用它们来训练一系列的舞蹈动作分类的机器学习模型. 本节介绍所使用的机器学习架构和培训参数,以及每个实验中选择的输入特性矢量的不同配置.

blocks.en: In all experiments we used a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) architecture with three convolutional blocks, as depicted in Fig. 3 . The input in each convolutional step is shown as a 2D array, with elements x i , j x_{i,j} , where the first dimension corresponds to the temporal domain (frames), while the second dimension is the number of input features per frame or in the case of the intermediate layers the number of filter outputs per frame. Each convolution step is followed by batch normalization, activation, and dropout. The final output is calculated after global average pooling and a dense layer as shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 在所有的实验中,我们使用了Temperal Convolutional Network(TCN)架构,其中有三个革命块,如图3所示。 每个演化步骤的输入显示为2D阵列,其中元素xi,jx_{i,j},其中第一个维度对应时间域(frames),而第二个维度是每个帧的输入特性数,或者中间层的每个帧的过滤输出数. 每一个进化步骤之后都进行批量正常化、激活和退学。 如图3所示,最终产出是在全球平均集合和密集层之后计算的。

blocks.en: Configuring a temporal convolutional network requires selecting several key hyperparameters, such as the number of filters in each layer, the size of the convolution kernel, and the dilation rates. As shown by Ahmed, et al. ( Ahmed and Karim, 2020 ) increasing the number of filters can have a major impact on the classification accuracy of a model, at the cost of an increase in computational time. For our experiment, we utilized increasing filter sizes along the 3 convolutional blocks. After preliminary testing, our models performed best with 75, 150, and 300 filters across the 3 blocks. Similar studies ( Abu Farha and Gall, 2020 ; Bai et al., 2018 ) found that a kernel of size k = 5 k=5 and dilation rates of d = 1 d=1 , 2, and 4 across 3 TCN blocks were effective in TCN architectures, so we adopted these hyperparameters in our experiments.

blocks.en: Each convolutional block was followed by a Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) as the activation function after batch normalization. Finally, a dropout layer completes each of the three structural blocks of our architecture. Using dropout layers for regularization can help increase robustness and the ability to generalize to new data ( Salehin and Kang, 2023 ) . Dropout layers have the hyperparameter of dropout rate, which affects how many neurons are turned off during training. For the purpose of human action recognition, Nan et al. ( Nan et al., 2021 ) found that a dropout rate around 0.2 was optimal, so in our preliminary tests we experimented with values 0.2 ± 0.1 0.2\pm 0.1 . A dropout rate of 0.3 performed best and hence was chosen for our experiments.

blocks.en: 4.1. Model training
blocks.zh: 4.1. 示范培训

blocks.en: The architecture described in the previous section was employed in a series of experiments to train machine learning models and assess their ability to correctly classify the dance moves in the Atunda data bank. Each video was divided into fixed-length clips using a sliding temporal window, which was advanced by a stride to reduce unnecessary repetition of frames between clips. To maintain a consistent amount of overlap across clip lengths, the input stride was set to one quarter of the clip length, resulting in 75% overlap between adjacent clips. To help prevent label bias caused by a lack of data in some types of dance moves, we evenly oversampled underrepresented movements so that each movement had the same number of clips in the training dataset.
blocks.zh: 上一节所描述的架构被用于一系列的实验,以训练机器学习模型,并评估其在阿通达数据库中正确分类舞蹈动作的能力. 每段视频都使用滑动时间窗口分为固定长度的片段,通过一个脚步推进,以减少片段间帧的不必要的重复. 为了在剪辑长度之间保持一致的重叠量,输入速度被设定为剪辑长度的四分之一,导致相邻的剪辑之间有75%的重叠. 为了帮助防止某些类型的舞蹈动作中由于缺乏数据而导致的标签偏差,我们均匀地对代表性不足的动作进行抽样,这样每个动作在训练数据集中都有同样数量的剪辑.

blocks.en: In all experiments, we used the same seeded 5-fold cross-validation stratified by video, applying early stopping with a patience of 10 based on validation accuracy and retaining the best-performing weights. Because we used the same cross-validation split for each experiment, the results are meaningfully comparable between experiments. In order to avoid data leakage, all clips from a video were exclusively assigned to one set. Since we stratify only by video, some performers may appear in both the training and validation sets; however, many performers appear in multiple movement classes (in 5.41 classes on average), so the impact on data leakage is anticipated to be small, as the model cannot solely rely on characteristics of the performer to distinguish between movements.
blocks.zh: 在所有实验中,我们使用同样的种子 5倍交叉验证分级 通过视频, 应用早期停止 耐心的10 基于验证的准确性 并保留最佳的重量。 因为我们对每个实验都采用了相同的交叉验证分法,结果在实验之间具有有意义的可比性. 为了避免数据泄露,视频中的所有片段全部分配给一组. 由于我们只能通过视频进行分层划分,有些表演者可能同时出现在培训和验证集中;然而,许多表演者出现在多个运动课(平均5.41课)中,因此对数据泄漏的影响预计很小,因为模型不能仅仅依靠表演者的特点来区分运动.

blocks.en: We first trained 6 models using different input data configurations of the MediaPipe data as described in Table 4 . In each of the first six models, we introduced a different type of input data starting from normalized landmarks in Model 1, world landmarks in Model 2, body angles in Model 3, velocities and accelerations in Models 4 and 5, respectively, and used data augmentation in Model 6.
blocks.zh: 我们首先利用表4所述MediaPipe数据的不同输入数据配置培训了6个模型。 在前六个模型的每一个模型中,我们都引入了不同类型的输入数据,分别来自模型1中规范的地标,模型2中的世界地标,模型3中的身体角度,模型4和模型5中的速度和加速度,以及模型6中使用的数据增强.

blocks.en: Then, with Models 6-17 we compared different pose sources as we increase the clip size. In all of the previous models we used 32 frames as a baseline clip length, while in Models 6-9 we tested clip lengths of 32, 64, 96, and 128 frames, respectively. These models also used the full features (joint positions, angles, velocity, acceleration) and data augmentation from Model 6. Increasing the clip length provides more temporal information to the model and improves classification by smoothing out movement variability. However, as the clip length approaches the video length, the number of training clips per training video decreases, which can create an imbalance in the training data, as videos vary in length. We repeated these experiments using FMPose3D ( Wang et al., 2026 ) for Models 10-13 and SAM4D ( Gao et al., 2025 ) for Models 14-17 as the pose sources to reduce our reliance on just the MediaPipe data and to compare how robust the different pose sources are at different clip lengths.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们用模型6 -17 比较了不同的姿势来源 随着我们增加剪辑尺寸。 在以前的所有模型中,我们使用32帧作为基线剪辑长度,而在6-9模型中,我们测试了32、64、96和128帧的剪辑长度。 这些模型还使用了模型6的全部特征(联合位置,角度,速度,加速度)和数据增强. 增加剪辑长度为模型提供了更多的时间信息,并通过平滑运动变异性来改进分类. 然而,随着剪辑长度接近视频长度,每部培训视频的培训剪辑数量减少,这可能会造成培训数据的不平衡,因为视频长度不同. 我们用FMPose3D(Wang等人,2026年)为模型10-13和SAM4D(Gao等人,2025年)为模型14-17重复了这些实验,作为姿势来源,以减少我们仅对MediaPipe数据的依赖,并比较不同姿势来源在不同剪辑长度上的强度.

blocks.en:
All 17 configurations were used to train TCN models with the architecture described in Fig. 3 using the Adam algorithm for optimization ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) . All training and testing experiments were performed using a NVIDIA GB10 GPU on a DGX Spark with PyTorch library version 2.10.0 (NVIDIA CUDA 13.0, cuDNN 9.15.1), NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.16.1, and scikit-learn 1.7.1 in Python 3.12.3.
The next section presents the results obtained from each model and discusses their performance in classifying dance moves. To facilitate the reproducibility of our experiments within an open science framework, the source code is available at https://github.com/digitalworlds/ATUNDA/tree/main/code .

所有17个配置都被用于用图3描述的架构来训练TCN模型,使用亚当算法进行优化(Kingma and Ba, 2015). . 所有培训和测试实验均使用NVIDIA GB10 GPU在DGX Spark上与PyTorch库版本2.10.0(NVIDIA CUDA 13.0,cuDNN 9.15.1),numPy 1.26.4,SciPy 1.16.1和Scikit-learn 1.7.1在Python 3.123.
下一节介绍每个模型获得的结果,并讨论它们在舞蹈动作分类方面的表现. 为便于在开放的科学框架内复制我们的实验,可在https://github.com/digitalworlds/ATUNDA/tree/main/code上查阅源代码。

blocks.en: 5. Results
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结果

blocks.en: Table 4 summarizes the results of our MediaPipe input ablation in Models 1-6, and Table 5 summarizes the results of our Pose-source and clip-length comparison in Models 6-17. The reported results were calculated by averaging the validation metrics across the 5-folds. The results indicate that the validation accuracy improved from 90.45% in Model 1 to 96.86% in Model 9 as a result of changing the type and size of the input feature vectors.
blocks.zh: 表4总结了我们MediaPipe在模型1-6中输入衰减的结果,表5总结了我们在模型6-17中Pose源和剪短比较的结果。 报告的结果是通过平均5倍的验证指标计算的。 结果显示,由于输入特征矢量的类型和大小发生变化,验证精度从模型1的90.45%提高到模型9的96.86%.

blocks.en: Table 4 . MediaPipe input ablation results. Values are reported as mean (standard deviation) expressed as a percentage.
blocks.zh: 表4. 媒体 管道输入衰减结果. 以百分比表示的数值为平均值(标准偏差)。

blocks.en: More specifically, a comparison between Models 1 and 2 reveals that world landmarks (93.05% validation accuracy) outperform normalized landmarks (90.45% validation accuracy), which is expected given their superior ability to represent 3D pose independently of scale and perspective. This led us to choose world landmarks as the more suitable data input for the remaining MediaPipe Models (2-9).
blocks.zh: 更具体地说,对模型1和2的比较表明,世界地标(93.05%的验证精度)的性能超过了正常化的地标(90.45%的验证精度),鉴于它们具有独立于规模和视角而代表3D的优越能力,预计这是预期的. 这使得我们选择了世界地标作为余下MediaPipe模型(2-9)更合适的数据输入.

blocks.en: In Models 3-5 we introduced the additional features angles, velocities, and accelerations as discussed in Sec. 3.2 . The results show an incremental improvement of the validation accuracy of 1.11% compared to performance without these additional features. Similarly, in Model 6 we introduced data augmentation as discussed in Sec. 4 . This produced comparable validation accuracy to Model 5 while slightly increasing Macro F1 and reducing the standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 在模型3-5中,我们引入了 Sec 中讨论的其他特征角度,速度和加速度. 3.2 (英语). 结果显示,与没有这些额外功能的性能相比,验证精度逐渐提高1.11%. 同样,在模式6中,我们采用了第4节所讨论的数据扩充。 这产生了与Model 5相似的验证精度,同时略微提高了Macro F1并降低了标准偏差.

blocks.en: Using Model 6 as our baseline, which outperformed all earlier configurations, we then focused on providing more temporal context to the TCN by increasing the input clip length, which had previously been fixed at 32 frames in all models up to Model 6. In Models 7–9, we increased the number of input frames from 32 up to 128 as shown in Table 5 . This increase further improved the validation accuracy by 2.32% to 96.86%.
blocks.zh: 使用模型6作为我们的基线,它比以前所有的配置都好,然后我们着重通过增加输入剪辑长度向TCN提供更多时间背景,该长度以前在所有模型中固定在32帧,直到模型 6个 如表5所示,在模式7-9中,我们把输入框从32个增加到128个。 这一增加进一步提高了验证准确度,提高了2.32%至96.86%.

This shows FMPose3D performing much worse than MediaPipe, especially at lower clip lengths, and SAM4D had comparable but slightly worse performance across the clip lengths, with a notably worse Macro F1. Figure 4 shows the performance of the three pose estimation methods from Table 5 as a plot of the clip length.

blocks.en: Referring to Table 1 , although 84 of the 397 videos (approximately 21%) were recorded at 60 fps instead of 30 fps, the high model accuracy suggests that frame rate differences do not prevent effective classification. In other words, the models appear to distinguish movement types based on positions and positional changes rather than movement speed, allowing for some creative variation in the timing and tempo of the dance moves.
blocks.zh: 参考表1,虽然397个视频中有84个(约21%)记录在60fps而不是30fps,但高模型精度表明帧率差异并不妨碍有效的分类. 换句话说,这些模型似乎根据位置和位置变化而不是运动速度来区分运动类型,使得舞蹈动作的时机和节奏有一定的创造性变化.

blocks.en: Table 6 . Per-class precision, recall, and F1-score for Model 9, the best-performing model.
blocks.zh: 表 6 妇女状况 每级精度,召回,和F1-分数 对于Model 9,最优秀的模型.

blocks.en: A more detailed view of the classification performance for each dance move is provided in Table 6 , which reports the precision, recall, and F1 scores per class. According to the table, most classes exhibit strong precision and recall, except Bante, which achieved a recall of only 0.75. This result is not unexpected, as Bante is the least represented movement in the dataset, referring back to Table 1 , Bante only has 96.60 seconds of video. This difference in data is amplified at 128 frame clip lengths because the videos for this movement are shorter than others. Expanding the dataset with additional recordings of Bante could help reduce the bias of the model against Bante.
blocks.zh: 表6更详细地介绍了每节舞蹈动作的分类性能,其中报告了每节课的精确度、召回率和F1分数。 根据该表,大多数班级表现出强烈的精确性和召回性,但班特除外,班特只实现了0.75的召回. 这个结果并非出乎意料,因为班特是数据集中代表度最低的移动,指回表1,班特只有96.60秒的视频. 这种数据差异以128帧的剪辑长度放大,因为这个运动的视频比其他的短. 扩大数据集,增加班特的录音,可有助于减少模型对班特的偏见.

blocks.en: In addition to the precision-recall table, we provide the confusion and error confusion matrices for Model 9 in Figure 5 . The class with the most misclassifications was Chocobodi, as highlighted in the error confusion matrix. However, unlike Bante, Chocobodi still achieved a recall of 0.94, largely because it is the most represented class in the dataset, with 408.23 seconds of video—approximately four times more than Bante, as well as a mostly 60 fps frame rate rather than 30 fps. The misclassification of Chocobodi as Jazzé was by far the most common error. This was likely in part due to these two movements having the most data, and notably the only two movements mostly recorded at 60 fps. Therefore, despite the model achieving a validation accuracy of nearly 97%, the observed misclassifications are likely influenced by class imbalance. Expanding the dataset, particularly for underrepresented classes, along with downsampling 60 fps videos, could help mitigate these errors and further improve overall performance.
blocks.zh: 除了精确召回表外,我们还提供了图5中模式9的混淆和错误混淆矩阵。 最错误分类的类是Chocobodi,如错误混淆矩阵中所强调的. 然而,与班特不同的是,乔科博迪仍然实现了0.94的召回,这主要是因为它是数据集中代表度最高的一类,408.23秒的视频——大约是班特的4倍,以及大部分是60fps帧率而不是30fps. 将Chocobodi错误地归类为Jazzé是迄今为止最常见的错误. 部分原因可能是这两种移动的数据最多,尤其是只有两种移动大多记录在60英尺以内。 因此,尽管模型的验证精度达到近97%,但观察到的分类错误很可能受到类失衡的影响. 扩大数据集,特别是代表性不足的类别,同时对60个fps视频进行下取样,可以帮助减轻这些错误,进一步改善总体业绩。

blocks.en: Finally, we repeated the experiments using several baseline classification methods to evaluate the separability of the movements using non-deep-learning approaches. The baseline methods included: Majority (predicting the class with the largest number of samples as the simplest baseline), Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM), Radial Basis Function (RBF) SVM, and Random Forest. Unlike the TCN architecture, these methods are not specifically designed to capture temporal dependencies in sequential data. Therefore, a temporal summary representation of the feature vectors was computed and used as input to the baseline classifiers. The temporal summary consisted of four statistics computed for each feature dimension across 128 frames: mean, standard deviation, minimum, and maximum. These statistics were calculated from the same input configuration used in the previous experiments reported in Table 5 , i.e., joint positions, angles, velocity, and acceleration. This representation substantially reduced the feature dimensionality for the baseline methods and improved both accuracy and computation time in our experiments. Table 7 reports the validation accuracy and Macro F1 score for each combination of pose estimation and classification method. As expected, the performance of all baseline methods was inferior to that of the TCN. The best baseline performance was achieved by the Random Forest classifier using MediaPipe pose data, with an accuracy only 1.98 percentage points lower and a Macro F1 score only 4.23 percentage points below those of the TCN. These results indicate that the movements are reasonably distinguishable using only the relative landmark positions captured through temporal pose statistics. The Random Forest classifier appears to effectively exploit these feature patterns to separate the movement classes, particularly given the relatively small number of classes. We anticipate that this performance gap will increase as the number of classes expands in the second and third phases of our data collection efforts.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们重复了使用若干基线分类方法进行的实验,以使用非深层学习方法评估运动的分离性。 基准方法包括:多数(预测样本数量最多的类别为最简单的基线)、线性支持矢量机(SVM)、放射性碱基函数(RBF)SVM和随机森林。 与TCN架构不同,这些方法并不是专门用来捕捉相继数据中的时间依赖性. 因此,计算了特征矢量的时间简要表示,并用作基准分类器的投入。 时间摘要包括针对128个框架的每个特征方面计算出的4个统计数据:平均、标准偏差、最低和最高。 这些统计数据是根据表5中所报告的先前实验中使用的相同的输入配置,即联合位置、角度、速度和加速度计算出来的。 这种表述大大降低了基准方法的特征维度,并改善了我们实验中的准确性和计算时间。 表7报告每个组合的姿势估计和分类方法的验证精度和Macro F1分数. 正如预期的那样,所有基准方法的性能都低于TCN。 最佳基准性能是通过使用MediaPipe post数据的随机森林分类器实现的,精度仅降低1.98个百分点,而Macro F1的分数仅比TCN的分数低4.23个百分点. 这些结果表明,仅使用通过时间变化统计得出的相对地标位置即可合理区分变动情况。 随机森林分类法似乎有效地利用这些特征模式来区分运动类,特别是考虑到运动类数量相对较少. 我们预计,随着我们数据收集工作的第二和第三阶段的班级数目增加,这一业绩差距将会扩大。

blocks.en: 6. Discussion
blocks.zh: 6个 讨论情况

blocks.en: This section discusses the results in the context of the broader goals of this project, outlines the limitations of the current study, and proposes future directions to address them.
blocks.zh: 本节结合该项目更广泛的目标讨论成果,概述当前研究的局限性,并提出今后解决这些问题的方向。

blocks.en: This study represents an initial step toward our broader vision of developing a robust framework for the classification of Afrogenic dance movements and establishing digital metrics of similarity. Such metrics could eventually be used to track the evolution of dance styles, support proper attribution, and contribute to the wider discussion around the protection of the creative contributions of dance artists. As a first step, this work focused on compiling a novel dataset and establishing baseline performance metrics to guide future studies. Despite the considerable number of videos and movement types included, we consider this study pilot in nature within the context of our long-term goals. With the generous support of the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, our interdisciplinary team is poised to expand the dataset by a factor of four by 2026. The data collection logistics and post-processing workflows developed in this pilot study have directly informed the design of the next phase of the project ( Pank et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 这项研究是朝着我们为非洲裔舞蹈运动分类和建立类似数字衡量标准制定有力框架的更广泛愿景迈出的第一步。 这种衡量标准最终可以用来跟踪舞蹈风格的演化,支持适当的归属,并有助于围绕保护舞蹈艺术家的创造性贡献进行更广泛的讨论. 作为第一步,这项工作的重点是汇编新的数据集和建立基准业绩衡量标准,以指导今后的研究。 尽管录影带和运动类型相当多,但我们认为这项研究的试点性质是结合我们的长期目标进行的。 在罗伯特·伍德·约翰逊基金会的慷慨支持下,我们的跨学科团队准备到2026年将数据集扩大四倍。 本次试点研究中开发的数据收集物流和加工后工作流程直接为下一阶段项目的设计提供了信息(Pank等人,2026年).

blocks.en: An important contribution of this work, not explicitly discussed elsewhere in the paper, is the development of the Atunda License, which enables creators to retain the rights to their performative videos contributed to the dataset. To design this license and ensure that the project promotes the ethical use of AI in the context of cultural heritage, we collaborated with experts in copyright law and user data rights. Users who license the Atunda dataset for AI model development or other research purposes are required to renew their license annually and re-download the dataset. If any contributors have removed their data in the interim, the updated dataset will reflect these changes upon renewal. By prioritizing creators’ control over their contributions, this approach ensures that data sharing advances AI research without compromising individual rights.
blocks.zh: 本文其他部分未明确讨论的这项工作的一个重要贡献是开发了Atunda许可证,使创作者能够保留对其为数据集贡献的表演录像的权利。 为了设计这一许可证并确保该项目促进在文化遗产方面道德地使用AI,我们与版权法和用户数据权利方面的专家进行了合作。 为AI模型开发或其他研究目的发放Atunda数据集许可证的用户必须每年延长许可证并重新下载数据集。 如果任何贡献者在过渡期间删除了数据,更新后的数据集将在更新时反映这些变化. 通过优先考虑创造者对其贡献的控制,这种方法确保数据共享在不损害个人权利的情况下推进AI研究.

blocks.en: As discussed in the results section, one limitation arises from the dataset itself. The class distribution was highly imbalanced, with classes like bante containing significantly fewer samples than others, which may have contributed to its lower performance metrics. This issue could be mitigated by incorporating more data. Moving forward, one of our primary goals is to expand the dataset with additional videos to provide richer information to the models and achieve better class balance. In this regard, following the completion of this pilot study, the QDance Center has developed a public data collection platform to systematically crowdsource a larger dataset featuring more dance move categories ( , 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 如成果一节所述,数据集本身有一个局限性。 班级分布高度不平衡,像bante这样的班级包含的样本比其他班级少很多,这也许是导致其性能指标较低的原因. 可以通过纳入更多数据来缓解这一问题。 展望未来,我们的首要目标之一是用更多的视频来扩展数据集,为模型提供更丰富的信息,实现更好的阶级平衡. 在这方面,在完成这项试点研究之后,QDance中心开发了一个公共数据收集平台,以系统化地将一个更大的数据集集成成更多的舞蹈动作类别(2025年)。

blocks.en: Furthermore, the architecture used in each of the deep-learning models was solely TCN-based. TCN architectures are known for capturing short-term dependencies, whereas recurrent-based architectures like LSTM’s can better handle long term connections. As seen in our results, increasing frame sizes of the input led to significantly better accuracies. This accuracy could possibly be further improved by creating an ensemble of the TCN architecture with an LSTM to better handle dependencies established in longer frame inputs ( Du et al., 2024 ) . Furthermore, the pose data for each frame were represented as a single vector. Restructuring the data into a spatial format based on the relative positions of body joints could potentially enable simultaneous convolution in both the spatial and temporal domains ( Nan et al., 2021 ) , a direction worth exploring.
blocks.zh: 此外,每个深层学习模型中使用的架构都完全基于TCN。 TCN架构以捕捉短期依赖性而闻名,而LSTM等经常性架构可以更好地处理长期连接. 从我们的成果中可以看出,投入的框架规模越来越大,导致速度明显改善。 这种准确性可能通过创建TCN架构的组合体而得到进一步提高,该架构采用LSTM,以更好地处理在较长框架投入中建立的依赖性(Du等人,2024年)。 此外,每个框架的姿势数据都以单一矢量表示。 根据身体关节的相对位置将数据调整为空间格式,有可能使空间和时间领域同时发生演化(Nan等人,2021年),这一方向值得探索。

blocks.en: While somewhat effective, the joint angle calculation was simplistic, as it computed only a single planar angle for each major joint. Incorporating additional angular information could better capture flexion-extension (bending) and pronation-supination (twisting) for each major joint in the upper and lower extremities, which could then be fed into the model. These additional angles would provide a more detailed representation of posture and could improve the model’s ability to distinguish between similar dance moves.
blocks.zh: 联合角度的计算虽然有些有效,但过于简单,因为它只计算每个主要关节的单个平面角度。 纳入额外的角信息可以更好地捕捉上下端每个主要关节的弹性延伸(bending)和亲和(twisting),然后可以输入模型。 这些额外的角度将更详细地反映姿态,并可提高模型区分类似舞蹈动作的能力。

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, this paper, to the best of our knowledge, presented the first systematically collected AI-ready video dataset of Afrogenic dance moves. Furthermore, the baseline analysis presented in this paper can serve as a benchmark for evaluating future approaches to dance movement classification, particularly within the understudied field of African and African diaspora performative culture. By making the Atunda dataset available under the carefully designed Atunda License, we enable researchers to explore cutting-edge machine learning applications while ensuring that creators retain control over their performative works. We envision this dataset and its associated framework as a foundation for future developments, including automated attribution systems, digital metrics of similarity, and tools that protect artists’ intellectual and creative rights in the evolving digital landscape.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些限制,但据我们所知,本文介绍了第一个系统收集的AI准备的非洲裔舞蹈动作视频数据集。 此外,本文件提出的基线分析可作为评估今后舞蹈运动分类方法的基准,特别是在非洲和非洲散居国外者表演文化研究不足的领域。 通过在精心设计的"阿通达许可证"下提供阿通达数据集,我们使得研究人员能够探索尖端的机器学习应用,同时确保创作者保留对其表演作品的控制. 我们设想这个数据集及其相关框架是未来发展的基础,包括自动化归属系统、类似性的数字计量以及保护艺术家在不断变化的数字环境中的知识和创造权的工具。
